units.source_text: “养父看了K的信大怒，立刻回了一封措辞严厉的信，声明再也不给这种欺骗父母的忤逆之子寄学费了。

en.t: When his adoptive father read K's letter, he was furious and immediately sent back a harshly worded reply, declaring that he would no longer send school expenses to such an unfilial son who had deceived his parents.

units.source_text: K给我看了信，又给我看了紧跟着收到的父亲的来信。

en.t: K showed me that letter, and also showed me the letter from his father that arrived right afterward.

units.source_text: 父亲的信同样满篇严厉的训斥，不逊于养父。

en.t: His father's letter was likewise filled with stern reproaches, no less severe than those of his adoptive father.

units.source_text: 也可能是觉得于情于理都对不住养父母吧，父亲说自家这边也不再管他了。

en.t: Perhaps because he felt, both morally and emotionally, that they owed an apology to the adoptive parents, his father wrote that their own family would no longer look after him either.

units.source_text: 由于发生了这件事，K是恢复原户籍，还是作些让步继续留在养父家，

en.t: Because of what had happened, whether K would return to his original family register or make some concession and remain in his adoptive household

units.source_text: 这些是以后考虑的问题，当务之急是必须解决每月所需的学费。

en.t: were matters to consider later; the urgent problem was that he had to find a way to cover the school expenses he needed each month.

units.source_text: 我问K对此事有什么打算，他说想去夜校教书。

en.t: I asked K what he intended to do about this, and he said he wanted to teach at a night school.

units.source_text: 那时候和现在比起来要好混得多，

en.t: In those days, compared with now, it was much easier to get by,

units.source_text: 找个打零工的活儿并不像你想象的那样费劲。

en.t: and finding some odd job was not nearly as difficult as you might imagine.

units.source_text: 因此，我想K是能够靠自己打工生活下去的。

en.t: So I thought K would be able to live by supporting himself through work.

units.source_text: 但是，我有我应负的责任。

en.t: But I had my own responsibility to bear.

units.source_text: 当初K违背养父家的期望走自己选择的道路时，我是支持他的，

en.t: When K had gone against the expectations of his adoptive family and taken the path he had chosen for himself, I had supported him,
so I could not simply stand by and do nothing.

units.source_text: 我马上提出要给他提供物质上的帮助，K非常干脆地拒绝了。

en.t: I immediately offered to give him material assistance, but K rejected it quite flatly.

units.source_text: 以他的个性，大概是觉得自食其力要比依靠朋友的帮助愉快得多吧。

en.t: Given his nature, he probably felt that supporting himself would be far more satisfying than relying on help from a friend.

units.source_text: 他说，既然上了大学，如果连自己都养不活，还算什么男子汉！

en.t: He said that since he had entered university, if he could not even support himself, what kind of man would he be?

units.source_text: 我不忍心为了尽自己的责任而伤害K的自尊心，便依了他不再提这事了。

en.t: I could not bear to wound K's pride merely to fulfill my own responsibility, so I yielded to him and did not bring the matter up again.
